answer: Referral bonds plus reputation decay kill sybil swarms. A newcomer enters through a sponsor locking $50 per referral, recorded as a relic whose score falls 10% per rogue agent it vouched. Minting 1,000 fakes costs $50,000 with 1,000 sponsors; one honest agent pays $50 and climbs the ledge, refunded for clean conduct. Entry favors patience: good conduct multiplies rewards, while shells abandoned where the raven circles lose bonds after 30 epochs.
